newsitem.title: MALTA: Infatuated Libyan lover shaves Maltese girl's hair.
newsitem.headline: Infatuated Libyan lover shaves Maltese girl's hair.

text.p: A Libyan man infatuated with a Maltese girl cut off her hair so she would feel embarassed if she left their apartment, the Times newspaper said on Tuesday.

Mohamed Jomoa M. Soweid, 21, of Tripoli, appeared in court on Monday accused of holding the young woman against her will, carrying a knife without a police permit and using violence to force the girl to submit to his will.
The prosecutor told the court that Soweid shaved the girl's head on October 1 so that she would stay with him.
Soweid was conditionally discharged for 18 months and deported from Malta.
